key_interpretation: Top human reference by percent identity = ULK1/ULK2 (ATG1 orthologs, members of PTHR24348 UNC-51 family), corroborating the PAINT/TreeGrafter placement independently of PANTHER.

The live best-HMM family PTHR44167 is a functionally UNCHARACTERIZED generic Ser/Thr kinase family; it does NOT assign a competing specific function, so it does not refute autophagy - the discrepancy is a best-hit methodology artifact of TreeGrafter, not biological evidence of loss/misplacement.

A0BFB4 is a bare kinase catalytic domain (381 aa). It LACKS the ULK/ATG1 C-terminal (MIT/CTD) ATG13/FIP200-binding & phagophore-targeting module, so MF (kinase activity, ATP binding) is strongly supported but CC/localization and specific BP terms cannot be confirmed from architecture and rest on IBA inference only.

Ciliate autophagy machinery is functional (Tetrahymena ATG8, VPS34 drive programmed nuclear death; PMIDs 24280724, 28123910), so an ATG1/ULK ortholog in Paramecium is biologically plausible, though some ATG genes are absent in some ciliates.
